Ridder
Rule Inspector for Dependency Diagrams, Exceptions, and Reports

Usage:
  ridder                  Open the interactive terminal interface.
  ridder tui              Explicitly open the interactive terminal interface.
  ridder generate-config --project <project.csproj> [--strategy <snapshot|conventions>] [--minimum-confidence <0..1>] [--minimum-support <count>] [--generate-documentation] [--include-input] [--output <ArchitecturalLevels.xml>] [--force]
  ridder export-config --project <project.csproj> [--output <ArchitecturalLevels.xml>] [--force]
  ridder documentation (--project <project.csproj> [--include-code-evidence] | --config <ArchitecturalLevels.xml>) [--include-input] [--output <architecture-documentation.md>] [--force]
  ridder report --project <project.csproj> [--output <architectural-violations.md>] [--force]
  ridder inspect (--project <project.csproj> | --config <ArchitecturalLevels.xml>) [--output <architecture-health.md>] [--force]
  ridder merge-config --config <file.xml> [--config <file.xml> ...] [--output <merged.xml>] [--force]
  ridder split-config --config <file.xml> [--output <directory>] [--force]

Options:
  --project, -p          Project file to load with MSBuildWorkspace.
  --config               XML settings file to document without loading a project.
  --output, -o           Output file or directory. Defaults to an input-local path.
  --configuration, -c    MSBuild configuration. Defaults to Release.
  --strategy             Config generation: snapshot or conventions. Defaults to snapshot.
  --minimum-confidence   Convention confidence from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.90.
  --minimum-support      Convention caller count. Defaults to 5.
  --include-code-evidence Include rule matches and violations in project documentation.
  --include-input        Include the input architecture XML in generated documentation.
  --generate-documentation Generate code-backed documentation with a new configuration.
  --force, -f            Overwrite an existing output file.

Aliases:
  scaffold-config -> 
[truncated]
